description.value: Rogue Kitchen & Wetbar is a full-service restaurant and bar anchored in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, offering a broad West Coast-inspired menu alongside an extensive cocktail list and live tap selection. The venue has both indoor and outdoor seating and runs a daily happy hour, making it a potential mid-ride or post-ride stop for cyclists exploring the waterfront area. Online ordering with curbside pickup is available, which suits cyclists who prefer a quick grab-and-go.
